facts.P1_fx_receipts: Probably yes, through a bank authorised to deal in foreign exchange.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes, in practice; transfers abroad are capped yearly since 2026.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register as a sole trader at the GUE with your BI; fee about AOA 21,380.
facts.L2_tax_id: Your NIF is the same as your identity card (BI) number.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Freelance income: 6.5% withheld by local companies, otherwise 25% on assessed income.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 14% VAT; no VAT under AOA 25 million; 7% simplified regime up to AOA 350m.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 22/11: notify the Data Protection Agency about your data processing.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can withdraw within seven working days for off-premises purchases.
facts.L7_incentives: No freelancer incentive; flat 6.5% for small traders and no VAT under AOA 25m.

watch_out.text: Individuals can transfer at most about USD 150,000 abroad a year.
